Hayden, saw Bolt made Affirm its default BNPL partner and teamed with Socure on Bolt ID.

A run of partnerships like that usually means more merchant accounts in play than the team can cover, and that is where good deals go quiet. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Bolt off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Bolt needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
